# Fetch

Fetch is a Freight and Package Transportation company. Fetch is a company that provides doorstep services for renters, including package, market, storage, trash, and renter help center services. They offer four services, one app, zero trips to the lobby, a dumpster, and a daily grind. Fetch employs 372 people (-1.6% YoY, -6 people) and has an annual revenue of $30M, founded in 2016. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Brazil.

## About

Fetch is the centralized community services platform behind modern apartment living. We unify the
daily services that shape the resident experience (including package management, valet trash, storage,
and market delivery) into one platform. By moving these operations offsite and managing them end to
end, Fetch removes daily work from onsite teams while delivering a simpler, more reliable experience
for residents. Today, Fetch supports nearly 400,000 apartment homes across more than 1,250+
communities in 25 major markets nationwide. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Fetch has delivered
over 50 million packages and saved tens of thousands of hours for onsite teams.

# Fetch

Fetch is a Software Development company. Fetch is a logistics company that provides shipping, receiving, and recycling services. They aim to make a digitalization and a necessary experience for businesses and individuals. Fetch employs 3 people (+50.0% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2015. Headquartered in Vantaa, Uusimaa, Finland. Its workforce is distributed across Finland and Estonia.

## About

Fetch by Enexus is a Finnish last mile logistics company focused on solving everyday delivery challenges with a smarter, more flexible approach. We serve over 2.5 million residents in the Helsinki region, handling more than 25,000 deliveries per month.

Our service model goes beyond traditional drop-offs. We combine deliveries with options to return, donate, or dispose of items — helping reduce unnecessary trips and supporting circular use. This also helps reduce “empty runs,” which still make up over 20% of transport kilometres in Europe.

We work closely with partners, data, and customers to build logistics systems that actually work — for people, for cities, and for the environment.

Currently operating in the Helsinki area with plans to expand step by step.
Try the service at myfetch.fi
Get in touch if you’d like to partner with us.
